findings.issue: RE did not conduct enhanced due diligence before entering into an agreement with the LSP.
findings.doc_evidence: Ganga Finance did not review FastFunds' technology, data privacy policies or past conduct before agreeing, because FastFunds is a well-known brand.

findings.issue: Outsourcing agreement with LSP dilutes or absolves the RE of its obligations under statutory or regulatory provisions.
findings.doc_evidence: FastFunds will source borrowers, run the app and handle collections for Ganga Finance. The two sides agreed the terms on a call and will start lending next week; no written contract has been signed.

findings.issue: RE did not impart necessary guidance to LSP acting as a recovery agent on fair recovery practices.
findings.doc_evidence: Ganga Finance has given FastFunds no guidance or training on fair recovery practices.

findings.issue: Loans are disbursed to borrowers' bank accounts, but the document does not confirm that the disbursal is directly into the borrower's bank account as required.
findings.doc_evidence: Loans are disbursed to borrowers' bank accounts and repaid directly to Ganga Finance.

findings.issue: RE did not conduct enhanced due diligence on the LSP's data privacy policies and storage systems.
findings.doc_evidence: Ganga Finance did not review FastFunds' technology, data privacy policies or past conduct before agreeing, because FastFunds is a well-known brand.

findings.issue: Flow of funds between borrower and RE is indirectly controlled by LSP.
findings.doc_evidence: FastFunds keeps only the borrower's name, phone and address needed for collections.
